_comment: Third-party tool and integration marks — NOT OpenMined's brand. Each is the trademark of its owner, used nominatively to identify the tool. Sourced from official brand resources (or CC0 Simple Icons glyphs for monochrome icons). Never recolor a mark where the owner's guidelines forbid it; never imply endorsement. OMDS color tokens do NOT apply to these. Icons named `icon.svg` use fill=currentColor (theme via `color`); `icon-color.svg` carries the official brand color. Lockups: `logo*.svg` is the color/primary lockup; `logo-mono.svg` is the 1-color (currentColor) variant. Google has no mono lockup (its guidelines forbid a monochrome Google logo). Color mode: every color file must read on both modes' surfaces (src/lib/tools.ts fails the build otherwise). A mark with dark ink gets a `dark` entry (official reversed files where available; derived ones say so in `derived`); a mark that reads anyway for a stated reason carries `modeCheck`.

github.name: GitHub
github.notes: Official (GitHub_Logos.zip). Monochrome by design — use black or white only per GitHub guidelines. Icon = the 2025 Invertocat (GitHub_Invertocat_Black.svg in currentColor; replaces the deprecated 2015 cat).
github.license: Trademark of GitHub, Inc. Black or white only; no recoloring or modification; no implied endorsement (https://brand.github.com/foundations/logo).

ramp.name: Ramp
ramp.notes: Official production lockup SVG (next.ramp.com), monochrome by design (currentColor). icon = the Ramp swoosh mark (community dashboard-icons set, single-color/currentColor).

google.name: Google
google.notes: icon-color = the official 4-color 'G' (DO NOT recolor — Google guidelines). icon.svg = a 1-color knockout of that same G geometry (currentColor). Lockups: 'Google Workspace' wordmark + plain 'Google' 4-color wordmark (Wikimedia, PD-textlogo), each with a currentColor knockout (Google discourages recoloring — prefer color externally). Individual Workspace product icons (Gmail/Drive/Calendar/…) live under `products/` — see the `products` block below.

products._comment: Google product icons (Workspace + Analytics + Cloud) — official 2020-generation multicolor artwork (Wikimedia Commons). COLOR-ONLY by Google's guidelines (no monochrome/recolored product icons), so no 1-color variant. Each keeps its intrinsic aspect ratio. <product>.svg = vector (web); <product>.png = 512px-tall transparent raster (for Notion/doc icons via link). Used nominatively to identify the product; never imply endorsement; never recolor.

notion.name: Notion
notion.notes: Monochrome by design (black + reversed white). Icon = the 'N'. lockup = N + 'Notion' wordmark (svgporn community CDN — Notion ships no fetchable official lockup file; verify against notion.so/brand).

asana.name: Asana
asana.notes: lockup = 3-dot symbol + 'asana' wordmark (Wikimedia Commons, PD-textlogo). Asana discourages standalone use of the symbol — prefer the lockup. Never place on a coral background.

slack.name: Slack
slack.notes: icon-color = the official 4-color hash from Slack's CDN — never recolor. icon.svg = monochrome glyph. lockup = 4-color hash + 'Slack' wordmark (Wikimedia Commons, PD-textlogo).

claude.name: Claude
claude.notes: Official (Anthropic press kit). Icon = the Claude Spark (clay #D97757). Lockup in Slate (default), Ivory (on dark), and one-color.

hubspot.name: HubSpot
hubspot.notes: Sprocket mark. lockup = sprocket + 'HubSpot' wordmark (Wikimedia Commons, PD-textlogo). Referential use only — keep your name more prominent, include an independence disclaimer.

1password.name: 1Password
1password.notes: Official lockup from the press CDN (mono black + white). Recent rebrand ships separate company and product marks — verify which is intended.

rippling.name: Rippling
rippling.notes: The current kit is black and white only (no plum). icon-color = the 3-ripple mark, the first path of the kit's black logo; dark = the same path from the kit's white logo. icon.svg = the mark in currentColor. lockup = the kit's black logo; dark = its white logo; mono = currentColor.
rippling.license: Trademark of Rippling People Center Inc. No published terms in the kit; nominative use.

sourceFiles.rippling/icon.svg: https://assets.ctfassets.net/k0itp0ir7ty4/3E4spjZts7XCMtyaT2mHHj/20a9ea4e44ec7d760f6e108c1cc0fafb/Rippling-Logos.zip → Full/SVG/Rippling Logo black.svg (the mark path, currentColor)

loom.name: Loom
loom.monoTerms: Atlassian's logo terms: don't compose or deconstruct the attribution logos (https://atlassian.design/foundations/logos). icon.svg (currentColor) is the burst alone: whether it is kept is the brand owner's and the design lead's decision.
loom.notes: Loom in Atlassian's brand: a blue #1868DB tile with the white burst. icon-color = Atlassian's own Loom icon (the SVG inside @atlaskit/logo 23.3.3, its CSS-variable fills resolved to their stated defaults #1868db and white; the default artwork, not the flagged 'refreshed' one). icon.svg = the burst alone in currentColor. lockup = Atlassian's Loom attribution lockup (Charlie type), light and dark as supplied. No currentColor lockup: the owner's terms forbid recoloring or altering its marks.
loom.license: Trademark of Atlassian. Don't compose or deconstruct the attribution logos; app logos come from Atlassian's logo component (https://atlassian.design/foundations/logos).

figma.name: Figma
figma.monoTerms: Figma's brand terms: don't modify the marks (https://www.figma.com/using-the-figma-brand/). icon.svg (currentColor) follows the set's one-color convention: whether it is kept is the brand owner's and the design lead's decision.
figma.notes: Multicolor mark in the 2024 palette (#FF3737 #FF7237 #874FFF #00B6FF #24CB71; never recolor the color file). icon-color = the kit's full-color icon. icon.svg = the 1-color silhouette (Simple Icons; same shapes). lockup = the kit's lockup (the icon on its black tile + 'Figma'). No currentColor lockup: the owner's terms forbid recoloring or altering its marks.
figma.license: Trademark of Figma, Inc. Nominative use if truthful, fair and not misleading; don't modify the marks (https://www.figma.com/using-the-figma-brand/).

linkedin.name: LinkedIn
linkedin.notes: Single-color brand (LinkedIn blue #0A66C2). icon = the 'in' bug (the 'in' knocked out of the rounded square); icon-color = same in brand blue, icon.svg = currentColor. Mark from Simple Icons (CC0, canonical 0 0 24 24, ~86%). lockup = the one-color 'Linked·in' logo in blue; mono = currentColor knockout. Per LinkedIn brand: don't alter the bug's proportions or recolor the color variant.

bluesky.name: Bluesky
bluesky.notes: Single-color butterfly mark (#1185FE). Simple Icons geometry, canonical 24-box @86%.

x.name: X (Twitter)
x.notes: Monochrome by design — the X mark IS the logo (black/white only per X brand toolkit); no wordmark lockup exists. Covers the former Twitter accounts.

adobe.name: Adobe
adobe.notes: Single-color 'A' mark in Adobe red (#FA0F00). Covers Adobe Creative Suite/Cloud references. lockup = A + 'Adobe' wordmark; mono = currentColor knockout.

aws.name: AWS
aws.notes: Two-tone mark ('aws' squid-ink #232F3E + smile #FF9900). icon-color = official two-tone fit to the 24-box (Slack technique); icon.svg = currentColor silhouette. Covers the AWS / Route 53 rows. lockup = same official logo at natural aspect.
gaps: official reversed (white type) file not fetched; dark/ variants are derived

dark.derived: OpenMined, 2026-10-12: the dark ink #252F3E set to white, as in the owner's reversed logo. Not an official file.

wpengine.name: WP Engine
wpengine.notes: The 2024 logomark (rounded tiles). icon-color = the kit's teal #0ECAD4 logomark; icon.svg = its navy logomark in currentColor. lockup = the kit's horizontal teal & navy logo; dark = teal & white. No currentColor lockup: WP Engine asks that its files be used without alterations.
wpengine.license: Trademark of WPEngine, Inc. Use the provided files without alterations (https://wpengine.com/brand-assets/).

plausible.name: Plausible Analytics
plausible.notes: The mark is a two-stop gradient (#909CF7 → #4B38D8). icon-color = the owner's favicon vector; icon.svg = the 1-color glyph (Simple Icons; same shape). lockup = the owner's logo (gradient mark + navy #1F2961 wordmark); mono = currentColor. Open-source (AGPL) project brand; no published logo terms.
gaps: no official dark-mode lockup (the wordmark is navy); use the mono lockup on dark
plausible.license: Trademark of Plausible Insights OÜ. No published logo terms; nominative use (AGPL covers the code, not the marks).

zapier.name: Zapier
zapier.notes: icon = the official post-2022 app badge (orange box + white wordmark — matches zapier.com favicon); icon-color in Zapier orange #FF4F00. lockup = the '_zapier' brandmark (orange underscore + near-black wordmark); mono = currentColor knockout.

wordpress.name: WordPress
wordpress.notes: The owner's W mark is gray #32373C or white; the blue #21759B was Simple Icons' legacy hex. icon-color = the W mark converted exactly from the owner's vector PDF (its two filled paths, operator for operator; no tracing). icon.svg = the same in currentColor. lockup = mark + 'WordPress' wordmark (still the older blue file; see gaps); mono = currentColor knockout. Trademark note: 'WordPress' (capital P) per foundation policy.
gaps: the owner's lockups are PDF and AI only (WordPress-logotype-standard.pdf); logo.svg is still the older blue file until one is converted the same way
the owner's white W is PNG only; the dark file is derived

dark.derived: OpenMined, 2026-11-20: the owner's W mark vector in white, as in their WordPress-logotype-wmark-white.png. Not an official vector.

wordpress.license: Trademark of the WordPress Foundation. OK on a page describing your products or services; never part of your own logo or branding (https://wordpressfoundation.org/trademark-policy/).

sourceFiles.wordpress/icon-color-dark.svg: https://s.w.org/style/images/about/WordPress-logotype-wmark.pdf (page 1 paths converted to SVG, white; derived)

azure.name: Microsoft Azure
azure.notes: icon-color = the official gradient 'A' mark fit to the 24-box (never recolor); icon.svg = currentColor silhouette (Simple Icons geometry).

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.monoTerms: OpenRouter's brand page: don't stretch, recolor or remix the marks (https://openrouter.ai/brand). icon.svg (currentColor) follows the set's one-color convention; whether these owners' marks are shown in one color is the brand owner's decision.
openrouter.notes: The 2026-07-13 glyph. icon-color = Grape #7624F4 (the owner's color for light backgrounds); dark = Volt #C8FF00 (theirs for dark). icon.svg = the Ink glyph in currentColor. lockup = horizontal glyph + wordmark (Grape, and Volt for dark). No currentColor lockup: OpenRouter asks that the marks not be recolored.
openrouter.license: Trademark of OpenRouter, Inc. Don't stretch, recolor or remix the marks (https://openrouter.ai/brand).

readthedocs.name: Read the Docs
readthedocs.notes: Monochrome by design (post-2023 simplified brand) — use black or theme via currentColor.

cursor.name: Cursor
cursor.notes: Monochrome cube mark — black/white by design; theme via currentColor.

pypi.name: PyPI
pypi.notes: icon-color = the owner's multicolor package-boxes mark (warehouse logo-small.svg; Inkscape style properties at their defaults dropped before the allowlist, nothing drawn changed). Dense: prefer 32px and up. icon.svg = the 1-color glyph (Simple Icons).
pypi.modeCheck: Isometric boxes with dark #353564 outlines and light faces, in PyPI blue and yellow: on light the outlines and the blue carry the mark, on dark the light faces do. The owner publishes no other version.
gaps: no official wordmark-lockup vector (community file is the bare mark only)
pypi.license: Trademark of the Python Software Foundation. No specific logo terms found; nominative use.

miro.name: Miro
miro.notes: icon-color = the official yellow tile (#FFDD33) with the negative-space M, fit to the 24-box; icon.svg = currentColor silhouette. lockup color-only (mark is negative space on yellow — no clean 1-color knockout).
gaps: lockup is color-only (negative-space mark, no clean mono)
miro.modeCheck: A tile with the mark cut into it: on light the black mark carries it (the yellow tile is faint), on dark the yellow tile does (the black is faint). Reads in both.

docker.name: Docker
docker.monoTerms: Docker's trademark guidelines: use only the approved colorways (https://www.docker.com/legal/trademark-guidelines/). icon.svg (currentColor) follows the set's one-color convention: whether it is kept is the brand owner's and the design lead's decision.
docker.notes: The 2026-11-19 mark (Moby redrawn). One color by design: Ether #101010 on light, Zero #FFFDFA on dark, both the owner's files (Base #6172FF is a background color in the owner's colorways, not the mark's). icon.svg = the Ether mark in currentColor. lockup = mark + 'docker' wordmark (Ether, and Zero for dark). No currentColor lockup: the owner's terms forbid recoloring or altering its marks.
docker.license: Trademark of Docker, Inc. Use only the approved colorways; no distortion or effects (https://www.docker.com/legal/trademark-guidelines/).

stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.notes: The September 2025 brand. icon-color = the owner's favicon vector (the white parallelogram on a blurple #533AFD tile); the kit has the wordmark only. icon.svg = the parallelogram alone in currentColor. lockup = the kit's wordmark in blurple, slate or white, the only colors Stripe allows for it, so there is no currentColor lockup. Don't use Simple Icons' stripe glyph: it is the retired 'S'.
stripe.license: Trademark of Stripe, Inc. Users may identify Stripe; don't modify the marks; the wordmark only in slate, blurple or white (https://stripe.com/marks/legal).

resend.name: Resend
resend.notes: Black and white by design (no color mark). icon-color = the owner's black icon; dark = their white icon. icon.svg = the icon in currentColor. lockup = the black wordmark; dark = the white. No currentColor lockup: Resend asks that its files not be altered.
resend.license: Trademark of Resend, Inc. Don't alter the logo files in any way; spelled 'Resend' (https://resend.com/brand).

linear.name: Linear

linear.license: Trademark of Linear. Graphics are proprietary: don't alter them, imply endorsement or combine them with other graphics without written consent (https://linear.app/brand).

substack.license: Trademark of Substack Inc. No changes to color, proportions or design; nominative reference allowed; written permission for anything implying partnership (https://substack.com/brand).
